{{Quote|Remember how the Mandos blockaded the Hydian Way during the war? How Coruscant was on the brink of starvation and riots, until some hero came along, broke the blockade, and saved the planet? Well, that hero was me.|[[Hylo Visz]]|<ref name="KotFE 9">{{TORcite|exp=kotfe|chapter=9}}</ref>}}
In [[3661 BBY]], during the [[Great Galactic War]], a '''battle''' occurred on the [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian Way]] between the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] warrior clans and the allied forces of a [[Hylo Visz's smuggling contingent|smuggling contingent]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. The [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]], led by the [[Mirialan/Legends|Mirialan]] [[Hylo Visz]], launched an attack on the Mandalorian's [[Blockade of the Hydian Way]]. Although they were nearly wiped out, but succeeded after they were joined by the forces of the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]], having been mobilized after the [[Republic Strategic Information Service|SIS]] was tipped off about the battle. Their victory ended [[Coruscant riots (3661 BBY)|rioting]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], but also provided an impetus for the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Sacking of Coruscant]] [[3653 BBY|several years later]].
